T: Never go full jungle. Go full snacks.
D: A group of pampered actors shooting a war film end up in a real jungle fight.
P: Serve the snacks when Portnoy starts begging for jelly beans.
S: he wants them very, very badly
A big bowl of mixed jelly beans, with homemade fruit pastilles: fruit purée, sugar and pectin cooked to 107C, set, cut and rolled in sugar.
the candy bar he's in the film to sell
Roasted peanuts bound with a chewy caramel of brown sugar, golden syrup and butter, pressed into a tray, coated in milk chocolate, cut into bars.
a nod to the Southeast Asian jungle
Small baguettes with pork pâté, char siu, pickled carrot and daikon, cucumber, coriander and chilli.
M: Beef bones roasted, simmered 6 hours with charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon, strained, seasoned with fish sauce, over rice noodles with raw sliced beef, herbs and lime.
the film set in the jungle
Green curry paste fried in coconut cream until it splits, chicken thigh, coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, Thai eggplant and basil. Jasmine rice.
W: Glutinous rice soaked overnight, steamed 25 minutes, soaked in warm coconut milk with sugar and salt, with ripe mango and a salty coconut sauce.
K: the energy drink Alpa Chino keeps plugging
Passionfruit, lime and ginger syrup topped with soda over ice, a mint sprig.

s.note: the candy bar he's in the film to sell
s.how: Boil 150g brown sugar, 3 tbsp golden syrup and 80g butter for 3 minutes. Stir in 250g roasted peanuts and press into a lined tray. Pour over 150g melted milk chocolate and chill. Cut into bars.

s.note: a nod to the Southeast Asian jungle
s.how: Quick-pickle a carrot and some daikon in vinegar and sugar. Split 2 small baguettes, spread with 100g pork pâté and fill with 200g char siu, pickles, cucumber, coriander and chilli. Cut into bites.

m.note: the film set in the jungle
m.how: Fry 3 tbsp green curry paste in the thick top of 800ml coconut milk until it splits. Add 800g sliced chicken thighs, the rest of the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar and Thai eggplant. Simmer 15 minutes and add Thai basil. Serve with 300g jasmine rice.

w.how: Soak 300g glutinous rice overnight, then steam 25 minutes. Stir in 250ml warm coconut milk with 60g sugar and salt and rest 20 minutes. Serve with 2 sliced mangoes, a spoon of salty coconut cream and sesame seeds.

d.note: the energy drink Alpa Chino keeps plugging
d.how: Simmer 100g sugar, 100ml water and sliced ginger for 5 minutes and cool. Mix with the pulp of 4 passionfruit and juice of 2 limes. Top with soda over ice and add mint.
